procedures.A: Imported split LTT, saved proposals and first-failure stopping
procedures.B: Imported split coupled, saved proposals and first-failure stopping
procedures.C: Same held-out coupled region, all saved proposals, fewest certified cells
procedures.D: Same full-data coupled region as F, all saved proposals, fewest certified cells
procedures.E: Same full-data coupled region, complete two-tree/pilot-order contiguous union
procedures.F: Imported full-data coupled complete two-tree/full-data-order contiguous union

candidate_handling: Retain exact saved partitions, indices, ordering and infinite pilot scores; pilot scores are not certificates
proposal_tie: Fewest cells, then earliest saved proposal index; identity is always safe
complete_search_tie: Existing verified pipeline select_families combined selector, unchanged local and family return rules; no global secondary-certificate-optimality claim
cell_certification: Existing exact coupled principal CP machinery; reuse compatible saved full/boundary records and proved above-2 rejection lower bounds; no pooled alternative
unresolved: Keep numerical failure separate from mathematical infinity and rigorous rejection; safe certified candidate or identity does not establish the unresolved count optimum
truth: Evaluate selected partitions after selection under the authoritative verified pipeline declared exact nominal law
accounting_identity: F-A = (B-A)+(C-B)+(D-C)+(E-D)+(F-E), checked per dataset and cap in exact rational arithmetic

uncertainty.condition: 90 paired datasets; pointwise Student 95% mean intervals
uncertainty.fixed_grid: Equal weights over 48 conditions; variance = sum_h(s_h^2/n_h)/48^2; approximate normal 95% Monte Carlo interval
uncertainty.subgroup: Same fixed-grid formula, equally weighted constituent conditions
uncertainty.binary: Per-condition two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals; do not pool heterogeneous conditions as one binomial
uncertainty.scope: Procedures and caps repeat datasets; no extra replications or adaptive best-of-six guarantee

execution.cell_cache_scope: Per dataset and saved region; context includes integer counts, allocation, root policy and exact endpoints; full-data cache shared by D and E
execution.timing_scope: Additional computation with saved region/cell reuse; not cold full-procedure speed comparisons

interpretation: Retrospective matched ablation; fraction 1/5 was selected for LTT, not optimally tuned for C; sequence decomposition is not unique causal attribution
